waypoints.name: Thunder Creek Trailhead (Colonial Creek Campground, Hwy 20)
waypoints.directions: Drive SR 20, the North Cascades Highway, to Colonial Creek Campground near milepost 130 on Diablo Lake. The Thunder Creek trail starts at the south end of the campground, at about 1,200 ft. Overnight stays in the park need a North Cascades backcountry permit.

waypoints.name: Mount Logan summit
waypoints.directions: Take the Thunder Creek Trail about 10 miles to the Fisher Creek Trail, then Fisher Creek Trail about 3 miles to just past a handrailed log bridge, and climb that stream's drainage off-trail to a lake camp near 5,160 ft. Climb south-southeast to Christmas Tree Col, drop onto the Banded Glacier and ascend it to the Banded-Douglas Col, then gain the northeast ridge on rock near 8,800 ft and scramble the Class 3-4 summit block.
